schema.text: When you travel by car, what do you do when streets or car parks are dirty or badly kept (litter, smells, broken glass)?

options.text: I notice it, but carry on as usual
It's unpleasant, but I still go that way
I avoid some streets or car parks
I stop using that route altogether

en.#It's unpleasant, but I still go that wa: It's unpleasant, but I still go that way
en.#I stop using that route altogether: I stop using that route altogether
en.#When you travel by car, what do you do: When you travel by car, what do you do when streets or car parks are dirty or badly kept (litter, smells, broken glass)?
